layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: MECHANISM OF INTERGRANULAR CORROSION OF Al-Cu

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ALLOYS*

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: J. R. GALVELE and S. M. DE DE MICHELI

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Comisión Nacional de Energía Atómica, Departamento de Metalurgia,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Avda. del Libertador 8250, Buenos Aires, Argentina

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract-The anodic behaviour of pure Al and some specially prepared Al-Cu alloys has been

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: studied to check the mechanism of intergranular corrosion of aged Al-4%Cu. A clear relationship

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: between pitting and intergranular corrosion has been found. Intergranular corrosion only occurs in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the presence of certain anions, and over a narrow range of potentials. Difference in pitting potentials,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rather than difference in electrode potentials, is the main factor in producing intergranular corrosion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The conditions of heat treatment, solution composition, and potential, at which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: intergranular corrosion appears, have been established.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Résumé—On a étudié le comportement de Al et de quelques alliages Al-Cu spécialement préparés

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: afin de vérifier le mécanisme de la corrosion intergranulaire de

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Cu vieilli. On a trouvé une

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: relation nette entre piqûration et corrosion intergranulaire. Celle-ci n'a lieu qu'en présence de certains

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: anions et dans un intervalle étroit de potentiel. La différence des potentiels de piqûration, plus que

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: celle des potentiels d’électrode, est le facteur essentiel de la corrosion intercristalline de

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Cu.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: On a établi les circonstances de traitement thermique, de composition de solution et de potentiel de

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: l’apparition de la corrosion intercristalline.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Zusammenfassung—Das anodische Verhalten von reinem Aluminium und einigen, besonders auf-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bereiteten Al-Cu Legierungen ist untersucht worden, um den Mechanismus von Korngrenzen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: korrosion von gealtertem Al-4%Cu zu prüfen. Es wurde ein deutliches Verhältnis zwischen Lochfrass

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: und Korngrenzenkorrosion gefunden. Korngrenzenkorrosion erfolgt nur bei Vorhandensein von

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bestimmten Anionen und über einen engen Potentialbereich. Unterschied in Lochfrass Potentialen zu

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: einem grösseren Grade als Unterschied in Elektroden Potentialen ist die Hauptursache, Korngrenzen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: korrosion von Al-4%Cu hervorzurufen. Die Bedingungen für Wärmebehandlung, Lösungszusam-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mensetzung und Potential, bei welchem Korngrenzenkorrosion erscheint, wurden festgelegt.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: INTRODUCTION

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: THE INTERGRANULAR corrosion of aged Al-4%Cu alloys has been the subject of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: numerous investigations.1-7 It is generally agreed that the microstructure of the aged

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Al-Cu alloy is the one represented in Fig. 1. At this stage of heat treatment the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: changes in the structure of the grain bodies are not yet detectable by common metallo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: graphic techniques, and for the present purposes are usually considered as a single

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: phase. At the grain boundaries, on the other hand, the precipitation rate is higher, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two phases can be observed, the θ phase, or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: , surrounded by the other phase, a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Cu-depleted zone, which, according to the equilibrium diagram (8), should approxi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mate to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Consequently in the generally accepted mechanism of intergranular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: corrosion¹-7 the aged Al-4%Cu alloy is described as a three-phase system having

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: anodic and cathodic zones. The copper-depleted zone along the grain boundaries is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the anode (phase I), whilst the grain bodies (phase II) and the intermetallic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (phase III) are cathodes. The intergranular corrosion of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: would then be a process

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in which a very small anode is in contact with a large cathode. In support of this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mechanism measurements made by various authors³- showed that during corrosion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: there was a difference in potentials of the order of 100 mV between the grain boundaries

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and the grain bodies. Nevertheless, a mechanism of anodic and cathodic zones does

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: not explain why the presence of Cl- is necessary to get intergranular corrosion, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: intergranular corrosion should occur in almost any corrosive medium. Therefore any

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mechanism of intergranular corrosion of aged

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: must explain the action of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the Cl- ions.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The purpose of the present work was to find out the function of the Cl-in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: intergranular corrosion of Al-Cu alloys. Specimens of each of the three phases present

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in the aged Al-4%Cu alloy were studied in Cl- solutions. It has been found that the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: intergranular corrosion of the aged

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alloy appears only over a certain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: potential range, and that it is related to the process of pitting of Al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and Al-0·2%Cu alloy were used.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the existence of critical potentials for pitting is supported by various authors,10-15

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: recent work has thrown doubts on the existence of such potentials,16-18 since pitting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: does not occur until after an induction period.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In view of this discrepancy of opinions, two types of experiments were made to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: study the pitting of Al in Cl- solutions.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In a first series of experiments 99.99%Al was immersed in deaerated 1M NaCl

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and the potential of the specimen was switched every 10 to 20 min from the passive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: range to the pitting range (Fig. 3). When the specimen is held at a low potential the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: current decreases to very small values, but if the potential is then switched to a higher

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: value, which is in the pitting range, the current increases by two or more orders of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: magnitude, and pits form on the surface of the metal. If the potential is switched back

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to the low initial value, the pitting stops and the metal repassivates. This experiment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can be repeated several times on the same specimen with the same results. If pitting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of Al in Cl- solutions is a time-dependent process, independent of the potential,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: once pitting has started it would not be expected to stop when the potential is decreased.

layout_dets.text: the c.d. increased by more than three orders of magnitude and pitting commenced.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Summing up, the results of the present work show that intergranular corrosion of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Al-Cu alloys is not due to a difference in potentials between grain boundaries and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: grain bodies, but to a difference in the breakdown potentials of those phases. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mechanism of intergranular corrosion of Al-Cu is found to be of the same nature as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the process of pitting of Al. It is concluded that intergranular corrosion of Al-Cu

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: will occur only under the following conditions:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. The alloy must have a solute-depleted zone along the grain boundaries.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. The corrosive medium should contain anions capable of breaking down the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: passivity of the Al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3. The breakdown potential of the depleted zone must be lower than that of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: grain bodies.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4. The corrosion potential of the alloy must be over the breakdown potential of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: depleted zone, and under the breakdown potential of the grain bodies.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: When the pitting potential is too high, as in the case of nitrate solutions, other

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: factors, like the morphology of pitting, could be important and are being studied at

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: present.
